column1: # The calls that read a document outside the shared reader (ADR-052, decision 5), per file:
# count<TAB>path, with `linux` as a third column for a file that is only compiled on Linux.
# scripts/ci/closed_reader_count.py compares this file with what clippy finds, both ways: a count
# that rises fails, and so does a line that names more calls than the code has. A pull request
# that moves a reader onto the shared reader lowers or removes its lines in the same change.
# ADR-052 admits one counted call in fix/mod.rs for generic YAML repair at the 7.0 cut.
# Not here: test code, and code behind a feature that is not on by default.
